categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches src/minisketch, which is explicitly covered by utils as a vendored subtree.
categories.rationale: Updates the vendored minisketch subtree to eliminate a compiler warning and unblock enabling -Wunused-const-variable across the build (#36275). The change declares the ID_TRANS singleton as inline constexpr under C++17 to avoid triggering internal linkage unused-variable warnings in translation units that include the header without referencing it.
